//provider: which service to search; ids come from providers/index.json
//giphy: settings under a provider's id are handed to that provider's module
//tenor: closed to new sign-ups since Jan 2026; kept for existing keys
//enterAction: what Enter and left-click do: file | link | paste | image
//historyLimit: searches to remember for Ctrl+Up; 0 records none
//linkStyle: what a copied link points at: page (share link) | direct (short .gif)
//pasteDelayMs: wait before the keystroke, so focus is back on your app
